contradictions.title: README shape limitations conflict with integrated RECT/L/U support
contradictions.description: README states that L/U forms and courtyards are unsupported, while automated integration tests verify RECT/L/U generation including a U courtyard in the tested candidate.
contradictions.impact: Documentation can understate current tested capabilities and mislead architecture discovery.
contradictions.notes: No documentation correction attempted during this audit stage.

contradictions.title: README persistence description conflicts with integrated exact-geometry restore path
contradictions.description: README describes saved designs as regenerated from inputs and strategies, while the integrated persistence test verifies that integrated RECT/L/U models are embedded and restored exactly in the tested round-trip.
contradictions.impact: The documented source-of-truth behavior for persistence differs between legacy and integrated paths.
contradictions.notes: Likely version/path drift; exact historical boundary remains to be mapped.

contradictions.title: Scoring ownership overlap between Mizan Score and home-design engine evaluation
contradictions.description: The codebase contains calculateMizanScore() with weighted quality axes and a separate home-design evaluation.score used by compareHomeModels(). This establishes overlapping scoring responsibilities, but not yet a proven runtime contradiction.
contradictions.impact: Score authority is ambiguous and could lead to duplicate or conflicting quality definitions if not resolved after baseline.
contradictions.notes: Do not consolidate during contradiction detection.

contradictions.title: Decision-like bestId exists outside the AZIZ-selected-model path
contradictions.description: The inspected UI path assigns state.model from runMultiEngineDesign().selectedModel, while compareHomeModels() independently computes bestId from evaluation.score. Static inspection does not show bestId replacing the selected model, so this is a decision-boundary overlap rather than a proven execution conflict.
contradictions.impact: There are two decision-like concepts: AZIZ selectedCandidateId and home-design bestId. Their intended ownership is not yet formally established.
contradictions.notes: Requires later architecture decision after baseline; no runtime conflict claimed.

contradictions.title: AZIZ scoring implementation overlaps declared score-definition boundary
contradictions.description: The system map says AZIZ must not own score-definition, while inspected AZIZ source contains score axes, weighted totals, ranking, and candidate selection logic.
contradictions.impact: Score ownership is not aligned between the intended system-map boundary and current implementation.
contradictions.notes: No resolution attempted during contradiction detection.

contradictions.title: Two Gemini engineering review paths coexist without a mapped boundary distinction
contradictions.description: The integrated pipeline uses reviewCandidate() before AZIZ selection, while the UI separately runs analyzeGeminiEngineering(state.model) after a model is selected. The current system map does not distinguish these two flows.
contradictions.impact: Engineering-review flow purpose and ownership are ambiguous in the current map; no harmful runtime conflict is proven.
contradictions.notes: No merge, refactor, or runtime change attempted.

lineageCandidates.title: geometryHash propagation beyond selected model requires lineage audit
lineageCandidates.description: The selected integrated model carries integration.geometryHash, and tests prove that the same selected model feeds 2D/3D/BOQ. The inspected downstream outputs do not yet have independently recorded output hashes or verified hash checks.
lineageCandidates.impact: Potential traceability gap only. Do not classify as LINEAGE_BREAK until LINEAGE_AUDIT.
